name: Blink Mini 2 (US)

radios.note: Blink's spec page lists 2.4 GHz 802.11b/g/n; the FAQ says it needs an always-on Wi-Fi connection.

matter.note: No Matter claim on Blink's pages, and no CSA certification listing for a Blink camera surfaced in search.

apple_home.note: No Blink page found that lists HomeKit for the Mini 2. Blink's FAQ for the Outdoor and Indoor 3rd Gen says HomeKit is not supported at launch, but that is a different model.

google_home.note: No Blink page found that lists Google Assistant for the Mini 2. Blink's FAQ for the Outdoor and Indoor 3rd Gen says it is not supported at launch, but that is a different model.

alexa.note: Through the Blink skill. Blink's Mini 2 features page lists live view on Echo and Fire devices with a screen, motion announcements, arming and disarming, and motion detection in Alexa routines. Live view started by voice lasts 5 minutes.

smartthings.note: No official Blink or SmartThings page found; only old forum posts, which are not cited.

home_assistant.note: The official Blink integration has limited Mini support: Mini cameras do not report the integration's sensors or battery status, and a Mini linked to a Sync Module cannot be armed or disarmed on its own. The docs refer to Mini cameras in general and do not name the Mini 2.

hubRequired.note: Blink says the Mini 2 does not need a Sync Module. A Sync Module 2 is only needed for local storage.

localControl.note: Blink does not state whether any control works without its cloud.

cameraType.note: Sold as a plug-in indoor camera. Blink says it can be used outdoors (IP65) with a separately sold outdoor power adapter.

power.note: Blink's FAQ says 5 V, 1 A USB power through the included adapter, or the Weather Resistant Power Adapter sold separately for outdoor use. The spec page lists a USB-C connector.

localStorage.note: Only with a Sync Module 2 in the same Blink system and a USB drive of 1–256 GB in it; clips then save to the drive when there is no subscription.

subscription.value: Cloud video storage, person detection (Blink plan)
subscription.note: Blink lists 60-day cloud storage in the US with a plan. Person detection and Extended Live View (up to 90 minutes) also need a subscription.

summary: Blink Mini 2 is a small plug-in 1080p camera with color night view, a built-in spotlight and two-way audio. It uses 5 V USB power and Wi-Fi, and can run outdoors with a separately sold adapter. Alexa is its supported voice platform. Local clips need a Sync Module 2 and USB drive.
caveats: Local storage needs a Sync Module 2 and a USB drive, both sold separately.
Cloud storage and person detection need a Blink subscription plan.
Home Assistant support for Mini cameras is limited.
Apple Home and Google Home support is not confirmed by Blink.
